title: Quotient product and cocone comparison, original steps 1 and 5
statement: Fix the prime, finite coefficient extension and scheme isomorphism $g:X\to Y$ with the strict quotient notation of [def-trf-isomorphism-strict-quotient-models]. For every flat-term K-flat complex $Q$, the canonical countable-product comparison $\phi_D:G_{\rm cx}\prod_nD_n(Q)\to\prod_nG_{\rm cx}D_n(Q)$ is invertible and satisfies $\phi_D\circ G_{\rm cx}(1-s_D)=(1-s_{GD})\circ\phi_D$. There is a natural isomorphism $\eta:G_{\rm cx}H D\simeq HG_{\rm tow}D$ whose composition with the first mapping-cocone projection is $G$ of that projection followed by $\phi_D$, and whose composition with the shifted second projection in degree $p+1$ is $G$ of that second projection followed by the degree-$p$ component of $\phi_D$, for every integer $p$. These equations specify both diagonal coordinates and zero mixed coordinates of the actual mapping cocone.

proof.text: Construct the completed-coefficient module inverse-image equivalence with SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence. Use the canonical site equivalence and the inverse of the completed coefficient isomorphism. The two coefficient identities follow from c followed by its inverse being the identity and the induced sheaf adjunction triangle. This is the same equivalence constructed internally in isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_exact, retained in a proved private helper.

The induced equivalence of cochain complexes preserves countable products, hence its canonical piComparison is an isomorphism. To prove the difference square, compose with each product projection, use towerTransitionEndomorphism_eq_iff to expand 1-s, piComparison_comp_π for the product arrow, and additivity and functoriality. Both sides become G(pr_n)-G(pr_(n+1)) followed by G(t_n). This argument is proved for arbitrary additive functors and strict towers in the private quotientDifferenceSquare helper before specializing to the quotient tower.

Apply podReindexingRoosComparison to the module inverse-image equivalence and an arbitrary strict tower. The canonical scalarRoosMap is invertible, and podReindexingRoosNaturality assembles its asIso components into a natural isomorphism on the category of strict towers. Whisker this isomorphism by the functor sending a good complex to its actual quotient tower.

The first projection formula is podReindexingRoosCoordinates applied to that quotient tower. Its second formula in degree p+1, simplified by (p+1)-1=p, is precisely the required shifted-coordinate formula. Thus the same natural isomorphism satisfies both specified diagonal equations, without any derived-limit normalization or exactness-of-products assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismQuotientRoosComparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] :
    (∀ Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
      IsIso (trfQuotientProductComparison l E g Q.obj)) ∧
    (∀ Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        (trfInverseImageComplex l E g).map (trfQuotientDifference l E Y Q.obj) ≫
            trfQuotientProductComparison l E g Q.obj =
          trfQuotientProductComparison l E g Q.obj ≫ trfInverseQuotientDifference l E g Q.obj) ∧
    ∃ (eta : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙
          trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y ⋙ integralOperationsRoosFunctor ⋙
            trfInverseImageComplex l E g ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y ⋙
          trfInverseImageTower l E g ⋙ integralOperationsRoosFunctor),
      (∀ Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        eta.hom.app Q ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
            (trfInverseQuotientDifference l E g Q.obj) =
          (trfInverseImageComplex l E g).map
              (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (trfQuotientDifference l E Y Q.obj)) ≫
            trfQuotientProductComparison l E g Q.obj) ∧
      -- Equality on the shifted b coordinate; together these specify a diagonal map.
      (∀ (Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) (p : ℤ),
        (eta.hom.app Q).f (p + 1) ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
              (trfInverseQuotientDifference l E g Q.obj)).v (p + 1) p
                (add_neg_cancel_right p 1) =
          (inverseImageIntegralModules l E g).map
              ((CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
                (trfQuotientDifference l E Y Q.obj)).v (p + 1) p
                  (add_neg_cancel_right p 1)) ≫
            (trfQuotientProductComparison l E g Q.obj).f p)
